stories.title: Münchner Flughafen: Polizei sucht mit Hubschrauber und Drohnen nach mutmaßlich freilaufendem Puma

en.title: Munich Airport: Police search with helicopter and drones for alleged loose puma
en.summary: A large cat was reportedly spotted near Munich Airport. Authorities are warning the public about the allegedly loose puma and advising parents to supervise children outdoors.

stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: AfD und BSW in Sachsen-Anhalt fordern Stopp deutscher Ukrainehilfe

en.title: War against Ukraine: AfD and BSW in Saxony-Anhalt demand halt to German Ukraine aid
en.summary: The AfD and BSW parties in Saxony-Anhalt are pushing to pressure the federal government. They plan to place an end to German Ukraine aid on the state parliament's agenda.

stories.title: Gedenkfeier in Berlin: Deutsche Spitzenpolitiker gedenken der Opfer des Hamas-Terrors

en.title: Memorial ceremony in Berlin: German top politicians commemorate victims of Hamas terror
en.summary: German political leaders commemorated victims of Hamas terror on the third anniversary of October 7, 2023. They called for fighting antisemitism while Israel's ambassador called for an offensive against antisemitic sentiment.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: BSW will mit AfD Ukraine-Antrag verabschieden

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: BSW wants to pass Ukraine motion with AfD
en.summary: The BSW and AfD plan their first joint substantive motion in the Saxony-Anhalt state parliament. They aim to pass measures ending Ukraine aid and lifting sanctions against Russia.

stories.title: Gedenken an Opfer des Hamas-Überfalls vor drei Jahren

en.title: Remembrance of victims of Hamas attack three years ago
en.summary: A commemoration is being held for those killed in a Hamas attack that occurred three years prior.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: Wie der CDU-Streit AfD-Mann Ulrich Siegmund ins Amt bringen könnte

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: How CDU conflict could bring AfD member Ulrich Siegmund into office
en.summary: An AfD politician's election as minister-president in Saxony-Anhalt is becoming increasingly likely as internal CDU divisions deepen, with the AfD seeking to exploit the party split.

stories.title: Merz über Sachsen-Anhalt: "Mit den Werten der CDU verträgt sich das nicht"

en.title: Merz on Saxony-Anhalt: "That is incompatible with CDU values"
en.summary: Chancellor Merz addresses concerns about whether CDU votes may have supported an AfD politician's election in Saxony-Anhalt, suggesting votes could have come from other parties.

stories.title: Kreis Erding: Hubschrauber und Drohnen sollen mutmaßlichen Puma suchen

en.title: Erding district: Helicopters and drones to search for suspected puma
en.summary: Police are launching a major search operation near Munich airport after a possible sighting of a loose puma in the area.

stories.title: Friedrich Merz: Stimmen für die AfD nicht mit den Werten der CDU vereinbar, False-Flag-Operation möglich

en.title: Friedrich Merz: Votes for the AfD incompatible with CDU values, false-flag operation possible
en.summary: CDU leader Friedrich Merz stated that voting for the AfD contradicts CDU values and supports extremists. The chancellor did not rule out the possibility of a false-flag operation in relation to CDU members voting for an AfD state parliament president.

stories.title: Newsblog zu den Landtagswahlen: Merz: SPD und Grüne müssen Linken-Bürgermeisterin Eralp in Berlin verhindern

en.title: News blog on state elections: Merz calls on SPD and Greens to prevent Left-affiliated mayor Eralp in Berlin
en.summary: Chancellor Merz appealed to SPD and Green parties to prevent a Left party member from becoming governing mayor of Berlin, citing antisemitism concerns in the city as part of his argument.

stories.title: Israel – Mutter von getöteter Hamas-Geisel: »Wenn ich in Panik gerate, rufe ich laut nach ihm«

en.title: Israel – Mother of slain Hamas hostage: "When I panic, I call out for him loudly"
en.summary: Rachel Goldberg-Polin, whose son Hersh was kidnapped by Hamas, tortured, and killed in Gaza, discusses how she processes her grief and finds comfort in Germany rather than seeking revenge.

stories.title: Sachsen-Anhalt: Merz: Stimmen für AfD-Mann unvereinbar mit Werten der CDU

en.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Merz says votes for AfD politician incompatible with CDU values
en.summary: Chancellor Merz stated that CDU members voting for an AfD politician undermine credibility and contradict party values. The source of four additional votes for AfD politician Tobias Rausch remains unclear.

stories.title: Dax aktuell: Dax baut die Verluste aus – und schließt trotzdem noch über der 25.000-Marke

en.title: Dax current: Dax extends losses – but still closes above the 25,000 mark
en.summary: The Dax index declined today due to weakness in oil and bond markets, reversing the previous day's gains while maintaining a position above 25,000 points.

stories.title: Helen Giza: Vorstandschefin von FMC geht abrupt– Aktie fällt deutlich

en.title: Helen Giza: FMC chief executive departs abruptly – stock falls sharply
en.summary: Helen Giza stepped down from her position leading the dialysis company after nearly four years, with the separation reportedly contentious, causing the company's share price to decline significantly.

stories.title: +++ Deutschland-Gipfel +++: Wildberger: „Wir haben ein Umsetzungsproblem, aber wir haben auch ein Erkenntnisproblem“

en.title: +++ Germany Summit +++: Felbermayr: "We have an implementation problem, but we also have a knowledge problem"
en.summary: Economist Felbermayr criticized Germany's transformation pace while politician Merz renewed criticism of plans for a Berlin left-wing government at an ongoing summit.

stories.title: Anleihen: „Investoren preisen Frankreich-Risiko ein“: Druck auf Staatsanleihen belastet Banken

en.title: Bonds: "Investors price in France risk": Pressure on government bonds weighs on banks
en.summary: Rising bond yields are increasing risk premiums for major French financial institutions, though experts do not yet identify a crisis situation, though banks face reduced competitive advantages.

stories.title: Russland: Altkanzler Schröder besucht Moskauer Supermarkt von Hyperglobus

en.title: Russia: Former Chancellor Schröder visits Hyperglobus supermarket in Moscow
en.summary: Despite the Ukraine war, the SPD politician maintains close ties to Russia and serves on the supervisory board of the supermarket chain, where he was greeted by applauding employees.
